topPros.title: extreme water-binding fibre
topPros.explanation: Chia is unusually good at turning a small amount into a thick, filling gel.

topPros.title: ALA omega-3 is the headline fat

topPros.title: easy to boost meals invisibly
topPros.explanation: A small spoonful can disappear into yogurt, oats, or smoothies.

topCons.title: works best with enough fluid
topCons.explanation: Dry chia is not the easiest food unless it is soaked or mixed properly.

topCons.title: phytates add an absorption caveat
topCons.explanation: The mineral numbers are high, but not all of that is automatically absorbed.

topCons.title: gel texture and digestion can be divisive
topCons.explanation: The same gel quality that helps satiety can put some people off.
